Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 18b (logging-only visibility round). Edit ONLY tools/claude-shell.mjs. This file builds the macOS seatbelt SANDBOX boundary and a network allow-list proxy for claude shell workers: it is security-sensitive. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, throws, sandbox profile contents, the proxy allow/deny decision, or anything a worker sees.

NOTE: docs/state/silent-failures.md lists lines 148/363/397/423 for this file, but the file has changed since; those four findings are now at the CURRENT lines below. Only these four catches:

No logger exists in this file. Use: console.error('[tools/claude-shell.mjs] <short context>:', ...)

1. Line ~170 `try { rootCommonDir = path.resolve(gitDir, (await readFile(path.join(gitDir, 'commondir'))).trim()); } catch { /* gitDir is itself the common dir */ }`: ENOENT is expected (not a linked worktree): silent. Log anything else (`error?.code ?? error?.message`). Keep the comment.
2. Line ~385 `try { host = new URL(request.url).hostname || host; } catch { /* origin-form request */ }` inside the proxy request handler: this runs PER REQUEST, and an origin-form URL throws a TypeError (code ERR_INVALID_URL) as the normal case: stay silent for `error?.code === 'ERR_INVALID_URL' || error instanceof TypeError`. Log anything else with `error?.name` and `error?.code` ONLY (never request.url or the message — it may carry worker-controlled text). Keep the comment.
3. Line ~419 `try { await fs.access(candidate, fs.constants.X_OK); return await fs.realpath(candidate); } catch { /* keep looking */ }` scanning PATH for the claude CLI: ENOENT, ENOTDIR, EACCES are expected (not in this dir / not executable): silent. Log anything else with the candidate path, then keep looking. Keep the comment.
4. Line ~445 `try { dirs.add(path.dirname(await realpath(home))); } catch { /* checked through the python link below */ }`: ENOENT/ENOTDIR expected: silent. Log anything else. Keep the comment.

Do NOT touch any other catch in this file (there are ~10 others; leave them exactly as they are, including line 393's client.on('error', () => {})). Do not refactor, reformat, rename, or change exports.

FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then run covering tests (grep tests/ for claude-shell) with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>, confirm green. Final summary: one line per changed line.
